biocontainers.name: bioconductor-sigfeature
biocontainers.summary: sigFeature: Significant feature selection using SVM-RFE & t-statistic

biotools.summary: This package provides a novel feature selection algorithm for binary classification using support vector machine recursive feature elimination SVM-RFE and t-statistic. In this feature selection process, the selected features are differentially significant between the two classes and also they are good classifier with higher degree of classification accuracy.
